name: youtube-agent-pro
description: Twenty-four Claude skills that run a YouTube channel end to end. Ideas scored before you film them, scripts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, titles and thumbnails linted as one pairing, a retention reader that names the second people leave, a funnel diagnoser that finds the one number holding a video back, a Shorts cutter, a cross-platform repurposer, series and playlist architecture, a sponsorship rate card from your own views, collab outreach, channel-page conversion, a seasonal trend calendar, a voiceprint that builds your voice.md from your own transcripts, production briefs, end-screen routing, chapters, SEO, comments, the weekly plan, a channel audit, and a virality engine that ranks your niche by outlier multiple rather than by channel size. Nothing publishes - every skill ends in a block you copy and the question: ship it, or change it?
